coverage_calibration_rows.coverage_calibration_class: metadata/provenance wrapper; not a statistical coverage claim
coverage_calibration_rows.coverage_or_calibration_object: Archive audit coverage, filesystem coverage, and registry coverage counts used only for package replay and restart.
coverage_calibration_rows.coverage_test: Archive coverage audits check file/ID/surface reachability; they do not test statistical coverage of a scientific inference procedure.
coverage_calibration_rows.calibration_failure_risk: Package coverage can be complete while statistical uncertainty, calibration, and physical model coverage remain absent.
coverage_calibration_rows.residual_gap: Metadata coverage is an archive-control fact only; it has no inferential coverage or posterior-calibration credit.
coverage_calibration_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer statistical calibration, physical reliability, or candidate support from archive coverage metadata.
